segments.text: Okay, Samsung kind of broke this, but
there is a way to fix it. So, this is
how easy swiping down into quick
settings on a Samsung phone used to be.
Boom. One swipe, there's my quick
settings. It should always be this easy.
But now, the latest update for 1 UI
changed it so that one swipe down is
just notifications, but swipe down from
the right corner to get to quick
settings. And then swipe left and right
between them, which is a little crazy. I
just want to swipe down and just get my
quick settings. This is bad. I don't
like it. I don't know anyone who likes
it. Luckily though, there's a way to fix
it. So, if you swipe down from that
corner and hit the corner, hit the pen
icon and hit panel settings, change it
from separate to together. And now, when
you swipe down, you'll always get the
quick settings every time, the way
you're supposed to. Other phones, please
don't copy Samsung here. Also subscribe
for more actually useful phone tips.
